title: HandoffSummary
description: Standardized 6-part structured handoff summary for clean-break session forking (IPSF-1.1).

forked_from_session_id.description: Unique identifier of the bloated parent conversation.

forked_at_step.description: Step index at which the fork occurred.

accumulated_tokens.description: Total prompt tokens accumulated in the parent conversation prior to fork.

active_goal.description: Exact problem being solved, bug being fixed, or milestone being executed.

settled_decisions.description: Locked-in architectural decisions and rejected alternatives to prevent looping.

modified_files.description: List of files created, modified, or deleted in the parent session.

failed_approaches.description: Approaches, commands, or libraries that were attempted and failed, strictly barring the child agent from retrying them.

open_risks.description: Known edge cases, lingering architectural risks, or unverified assumptions.

immediate_next_step.description: Exact next command, test, or code change to execute right now.
